steps.note: Cream of 35–40 % fat, pasteurised or not, is heated in a plate heat exchanger.
Phase inversion, which breaks the globules and frees the fat.
The final concentrator sends the oil out as the light phase.
Dehydrated until the moisture is 0.1 % or less.
